title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Science Communication and Public Dialogue
prompt: In many countries, scientific issues such as climate change, vaccine safety and artificial intelligence are debated far beyond the laboratory, yet public discussion is often dominated by misinformation and polarised opinion. Some people argue that scientists should therefore spend more time communicating directly with ordinary citizens, while others believe their priority should remain research and that public engagement is the responsibility of journalists and educators. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain which view you find more convincing and suggest at least one practical way to improve the quality of public dialogue about science. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请先分别说明两种观点：科学家应更多直接参与公众交流，以及科学家应专注研究、由媒体与教育者承担传播责任；随后明确给出你自己的立场并说明理由。务必提出至少一种提升科学公共讨论质量的具体做法，并评估其可行性。全文不少于250词，建议用约40分钟，先花5分钟规划立场与两个主体段，再留5分钟检查任务回应与连贯性。
